blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. did not order the P50-million bounty for the arrest of Sen. Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa, which the Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) and the Philippine National Police (PNP) issued under their mandates, the Palace said Monday. According to Palace Press Officer Claire Castro, Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla and the PNP leadership are responsible for the operation. READ: PNP to Sen. Bato dela Rosa: You have one week to surrender The reward, she added, would come from the confidential and intelligence funds of the DILG and PNP, which she explained are reserved […]...
